title: Hello, Friends!
communicative_goal: Greet, introduce yourself, ask and say names, say goodbye.
unit_end_capability: Learner can greet a peer, say their name, ask a peer's name, and say goodbye.

lessons.objective: Greet and leave politely in a classroom welcome scene.
Introduce yourself with a clear name sentence.

lessons.target_language: What's your name? — My name is ___.
lessons.objective: Ask and answer name questions with a partner.

lessons.target_language: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you, too.
lessons.objective: Use meeting language in a short friend-introduction story.

lessons.target_language: Hello, I'm ___. What's your name? Nice to meet you. Goodbye!
lessons.objective: Integrate greeting + name + goodbye in a class party mission.
